summary: Eagle Accounting is a Cairns CPA practice (about 11 staff) run by directors Chris Ganfield and Miriam Eagle, specialising in management rights, medical, hospitality and construction clients. It offers Xero and MYOB bookkeeping and payroll, trust account audit and an external CFO function. Little recent public content was found, so personalisation rests on service and person pages.

hooks.text: Chris runs the audit function (real estate trust accounts) and the firm sells Xero/MYOB bookkeeping and payroll, both reconciliation-heavy.
Management rights specialism means recurring, similar ledgers across motel and resort clients, which suits repeatable reconciliation.
External CFO function sits on top of bookkeeping work, so faster reconciling frees time for advice.

risks.text: Small regional firm (about 11 staff) with a Xero/MYOB specialist in-house; may be comfortable with current manual process.
Hiring evidence is from 2021, so not a current growth signal.

gaps: No recent (2025-2026) LinkedIn posts, news or podcast appearances found for Chris or the firm.
No Xero partner directory entry or AI/automation tool mentions found.
Blog post date not shown on the archive page.
